Water turned into Wine

Richard Crashaw (G.) (c. 1613–1649)

J
OHN II.
 
1–11
.
W
HENCE
 that blush upon thy brow,
Fair Nymph of the waters, now?
Mark the glow all rosy red
Of the stream astoniéd.
All the guests in tumult rush’d
The shy Nymph saw her God and blush’d.
